about: I am a final-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student at Sakarya University of Applied Sciences, expected to graduate in 2027. My focus is analog circuit design, PCB prototyping and embedded systems.
I lead a TÜBİTAK 2209-A supported research project: a wireless device that reads EMG, EKG and EOG signals through one shared analog front-end and sends them over Bluetooth Low Energy.

Since 2017 I have also worked in my family’s medical devices business, Şam Şerif. I started as Assistant Sales Manager and grew into General Manager and partner. I handle procurement with international manufacturers and suppliers, B2B sales to hospitals, clinics and distributors, and technical support from tender preparation to after-sales.
This is what I bring: I can design and build the electronics, and I understand how medical devices are bought, sold and used.
